import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial, DoubleSide, Color } from 'three/webgpu';
import { vec3, mix, uv, screenUV } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry } = ctx.THREE;
  const group = new Group();

  const activeTimelines = [];
  const disposableResources = [];
  let isCleanedUp = false;

  // 1. PALETTE SETUP
  const colors = config.intent?.visualSpec?.colors ?? {
    ink: '#16161d',
    paper: '#e8ecf2',
    accent: '#ff2a38',
    surface: '#0b0b10'
  };

  const inkColor = new Color(colors.ink);
  const paperColor = new Color(colors.paper);
  const accentColor = new Color(colors.accent);
  const surfaceColor = new Color(colors.surface);

  // 2. BACKDROP CARD BASE
  const width = 3.6;
  const height = 1.8;
  const geometry = new PlaneGeometry(width, height);
  disposableResources.push(geometry);

  const material = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    side: DoubleSide,
    transparent: true
  });
  disposableResources.push(material);

  // Engineered Gradient Surface: Surface Near-Black to Ink Dark Blue/Grey
  const vUv = uv();
  const gradNode = mix(
    vec3(surfaceColor.r, surfaceColor.g, surfaceColor.b),
    vec3(inkColor.r, inkColor.g, inkColor.b),
    vUv.y
  );
  
  // Subtle structural procedural grain
  const grainSeed = screenUV().mul(250.0);
  const grain = grainSeed.x.sin().mul(grainSeed.y.cos()).fract().mul(0.04);
  const finalColorNode = gradNode.add(grain);

  material.colorNode = finalColorNode;

  const cardMesh = new Mesh(geometry, material);
  group.add(cardMesh);

  // 3. TEXT LAYER (Sourced dynamically or fallback to spec copy)
  const textItems = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const headlineCopy = textItems.find(item => item.role === 'headline' || item.text.includes('Features'))?.text ?? "Features 2";

  const titleText = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(headlineCopy, {
    fontSize: 0.18,
    color: colors.paper,
    align: 'center'
  });
  // Tiny Z offset to prevent depth fighting
  titleText.position.set(0, 0.15, 0.02);
  group.add(titleText);

  // Secondary Atelier Label (JetBrains Mono vibe)
  const subText = ctx.fontAtlas.createText("NOVA SYSTEM LABS", {
    fontSize: 0.07,
    color: colors.accent,
    align: 'center',
    letterSpacingPx: 3
  });
  subText.position.set(0, -0.22, 0.02);
  group.add(subText);

  // Structural Accent Divider
  const lineGeom = new PlaneGeometry(0.8, 0.015);
  disposableResources.push(lineGeom);
  const lineMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ color: colors.accent });
  disposableResources.push(lineMat);
  const lineMesh = new Mesh(lineGeom, lineMat);
  lineMesh.position.set(0, -0.05, 0.02);
  group.add(lineMesh);

  // 4. IMAGE INTEGRATION (IF PROVIDED)
  const imageUrl = config.imageUrl ?? "/prism-mock/home/nodes/orb-decor.png";
  if (imageUrl) {
    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(imageUrl).then((tex) => {
      if (isCleanedUp) {
        tex.dispose();
        return;
      }
      disposableResources.push(tex);

      const thumbGeom = new PlaneGeometry(0.6, 0.6);
      disposableResources.push(thumbGeom);

      const thumbMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
        map: tex,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.85
      });
      disposableResources.push(thumbMat);

      const thumbMesh = new Mesh(thumbGeom, thumbMat);
      thumbMesh.position.set(0, 0.5, 0.03);
      group.add(thumbMesh);
    }).catch(err => {
      console.warn("Failed to load orb-decor image:", err);
    });
  }

  // 5. MOTION ENTRANCE
  group.position.y += 0.3;
  group.scale.set(0.92, 0.92, 0.92);
  
  const settleTimeline = gsap.timeline();
  activeTimelines.push(settleTimeline);

  settleTimeline.to(group.position, {
    y: 0,
    duration: 0.9,
    ease: "power4.out"
  });
  settleTimeline.to(group.scale, {
    x: 1,
    y: 1,
    z: 1,
    duration: 0.9,
    ease: "power4.out"
  }, "<");

  // 6. ROBUST CLEANUP CONTRACT
  group.userData = {
    cleanup() {
      isCleanedUp = true;
      
      // Kill all GSAP operations safely
      activeTimelines.forEach(timeline => {
        if (timeline) timeline.kill();
      });

      // Dispose all GPU assets explicitly
      disposableResources.forEach(resource => {
        if (resource && typeof resource.dispose === 'function') {
          resource.dispose();
        }
      });
    }
  };

  return group;
}
